newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN BLUE CHIPS STABLE TO LOWER IN LIGHT TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN BLUE CHIPS STABLE TO LOWER IN LIGHT TRADE.

text.p: Latvian leading shares were stable to lower in sluggish trade on Tuesday and dealers said they hoped that cheap prices could lure buyers back to the market.
Overall market volume was only 51,000 lats and the bourse index slipped 0.38 percent to 383.96. The Rietumu index inched down 0.39 percent to 149.73.
Of the four official list stocks quoted, two eased and two held steady.
Unibanka was stable at 3.33 lats in light trade of 3,800 lats.
Dealers said the bank had room to grow and could help pull the rest of the market, which has been laid low by summer, up with it.
"Unibanka looks comparatively cheap and could rise to 3.50 lats," said one broker.
Dealers said that many other prices looked low at the moment and could bring investors back to the illiquid market.
In the long run, most analysts say the bourse needs bigger and more profitable and transparant companies to really take off.
It has also suffered from competition with the local debt and privatisation voucher markets, which are regarded as better bets at the moment.
